Chapter 6710: You Lose, Sacred Teacher

Chapter 6710: You Lose, Sacred Teacher

The laws from the tree coiled around the fused body before inserting themselves like tubes. The tubes then absorbed primordial particles scattered all over the world.

Everyone sensed their primordial powers flowing away but was helpless. A new space opened behind the body and out came Taichu’s tree.

Taichu himself disappeared while his tree, or the primordial will, fused with the shored body. The being became increasingly ethereal and was reborn again.

“Primordial Reconstruction!” It roared and temporarily blinded everyone including overlords.

The primordial essences from the past traveled to the past where Li Qiye awaited in his chaos form. This primordial tsunami was also imbued with the high heaven’s power.

It attempted to re-create the primordial world, meaning it needed to take down Chaos first.

“Chaos.” Li Qiye uttered and unleashed destruction, leaving nothing behind but chaos. He wiped away all affinities to prevent reconstruction.

However, the heavenly being remained in the void and continued releasing more primordial affinity.

“Rumble!” The flood of chaos struck it repeatedly but it continued onward, empowered by the primordial tree.

Each step was one destroyed epoch until it reached the time of chaos. Those capable of watching were in awe.

The two battled on the river of time but if this were to return to the present, everything would be finished.

“Bam!” The being finally made it to Li Qiye’s area.

“Chaos Terminus.” Suddenly, the flow of chaos affinity stopped and focused into a single beam.

Before this, the celestial being endured the chaos and made it this far due to the primordial laws and the tree. Any wound would be healed instantly.

However, the concentrated beam pierced through its chest instantly.

“Primordial will!” Despite the injury, the being grabbed the tree behind and pierced Li Qiye’s chest like a spear.

This fatal blow from the primordial will could slay celestial immortals and ultimate beasts alike. Moreover, laws emanated from the tree and were linked to the pierced chest, stitching it together.

The heavenly body survived the chaos beam, proving it to be unkillable.

“You lose, Sacred Teacher, we are unkillable.” It spoke.

All three entities within were ecstatic since they survived the beam and healed in no time at all. The primordial will was truly magical. Now, they finally resembled the high heaven.

The primordial could be destroyed but they would be reborn again.

“Is that so?” Li Qiye smiled while still in his chaos state. Alas, it seemed to be dying.
